title: UneceCoordinateSourceSystem
description:
Properties defining a geographical coordinate source system used in different places around the world to identify
locations on the earth.

identifier.description: The identifier for this geographical coordinate source system.

signalSourceAvailableQuantity.description: The quantity of signal source available for this geographical coordinate source system.

sourceTypeCode.description: The code specifying a type of source for this geographical coordinate source system.

toleranceMeasure.description: The measure of the tolerance of this geographical coordinate source system.

usedSignalSourceQuantity.description: The quantity of the used signal source of this geographical coordinate source system.
